Wrangler Air, own printed box 60×100×36 with snap lid, schematic B (ADC)

Printed box, walls 2 mm, flat 2 mm lid on four snap hooks. DinMeter in the upper end wall, two M12 cable glands in the lower end wall. Relay left, ADC right (Grove 5 cm and 10 cm); right gland: sensor wires orange, blue, yellow to the ADC and the violet ARB wire, left gland: power. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
